notes.title: NEW Update v0.0.05H1 - Hotfix + Adding Difficulty Settings
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42053219/ab2b64f918e0bb789172dac9fb0b64f18fbea01f.jpg

Intro:

First things first, thank you all for the interest in yosemite Forest Ranger, and most of all for all the Feedback I've been receiving! And because of that this is the first small update that honours some of that feedback! 
Fixed some small things, Added Difficulty Settings and Started new things.

Update v0.0.05H1:

New Features:

 Added Difficulty Settings - Available in the GamePlay Settings. (These will only work while Playing, e.g. NOT in the Main Menu.)


Fixes:

 Shrunk the Death bag Back pack.. xD
 Fixed some of the POIs not showing their Proxy Meshes (Low Res Versions) from far away.



Extra Info:
Difficulty Settings:
The Difficulty Settings come in three settings. Relaxing, Default and  Survival.
For now the Difficulty Settings only have influence on the Stats; Food, Hydration and Stamina. 
So in the back end I work with multipliers the default is x1. 
Relaxing does a x0.5 and Survival does a x2.
Making all the bars go either half as fast (of twice as slow) or twice as fast.

I'm not very good at explaining it. But I hope you guys get it! :P 

Like it's set everywhere, Make sure you change the settings when in game. If you find your changes not working, try changing them again when in game!
This is just the start of difficulty settings, I'm thinking and exploring of where else to apply them, so let me know if you have any ideas!


What is next?
I've been working on several different things, I've started overhauling the Farming System, or at least swapped some of the meshes. I already started this already, so you might find some bugs there.

I'm also looking into adding Predatory Animals in the next update, and ofcourse ways to deter them.

AND if that's not enough I'm also looking into the Horse Riding and Map expansion. But maybe I'll do that in the next update. And push this one out in between!


And as always feel free to drop your suggestions in the Discord or here on the Steam Forums, as well as questions and experiences!


---------------------------------------------------------

If you want to see more about the game, Raptor, a Youtuber has been playing the game on his channel, so feel free to check those out!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-XVVmQqymfI
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5bYeVSUHbA8


As always happy gaming, I hope you'll enjoy the update!
Thanks for your support and patience! <3

notes.title: NEW Update v0.0.05 - Let there be Music! Radio Station Quest.
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42053219/3bbe86c1a2285b3353fcf9b75d056704df552a6c.jpg

Intro:

First things first, I'm sorry this Update took so long.. (Jeez, I feel like I start these Update logs the same every time..)
However this update will be great! At least I hope so!

In this Update you'll get to fix the Radio Tower and have the Radio broadcasting throughout the valley again.
As you may remember from the intro video the Radio Tower got destroyed by a Lightning Strike..
DJ T. the host of the Yosemite Park Public Radio, whom you might remember from the into video, will ask you to help out by fixing the Radio Tower.  You can find a letter on your windshield, which will get you started.
By searching and acquiring a few items as well as than solving some puzzles you can repair the Radio Station.
When you finished everything and the Radio is on again.. Be sure to check out your mailbox! ;)

I wanted these puzzles and Item searching to be a challenge, therefore you must really take your time to explore.

I purposefully want the searching and puzzles to be bit hard, so there will be virtually no hand holding. 

However if you get stuck, don't be afraid to reach out! We'd love to help out and help you get on your way again! 

Update v0.0.05:

New Features:

 POI Radio Station is a completely new and explorable building.
 Puzzles and new Items added for Radio Tower
 A whole Radio Station has been created through some smart tech in the backend. Making the radio station feel like a live radio.
 Interactable Radios can be found at several POIs and Public buildings will have a radio playing.
 Car Radio - While in the car you can turn on the Radio
 At the Hardware Store you can buy radios you can place inside your own buildings on your own Landplot.
 Tons more...


Changes:

 Added Early Access Disclaimer on begin screen.
 Changed default movement to walking (instead of jogging).
 Music slider in the Audio menu now works for the Radio as well.
 A bunch, I don't even remember..


Fixes:

 Fixed several Saving issues, like Trunk of car not saving, items in cupboards and such not saving.
 Fixed some NPC cars not having lights.
 Fixed raining inside one of the POIs.
 Fixed FP and TP issues while driving in car.
 Tried to fix interaction for butchering on rabbits.


Nerdy Dev Stuff:

 Changed the interaction trace to start from Theo's head instead of the camera. Makes the interaction a bit more engaged.



Extra Info:
Music:
The Music from the Radio is 100% Copyright free!
I used SunoAI and some other tech to make the music, as long as I'm doing this Solo and don't have any budget, this will have to do for now. Hopefully later down the line we will have the ability to get some artists on board!

As a content creator myself I understand the struggles and frustrations around Copyright issues on Youtube (or Twitch) and I made sure you guys shouldn't have any, if you do run into this please let me know ASAP!

Tips Advice:
- I'd recommend starting a new game. There might be some issues with the Save System
- Again, if you get stuck with the quest, reach out to us, on Discord or Steam Forums, so we can guide you! 


What is next?
Next up.. Hmm.. Good one, I was thinking of going for some map expansion? 
A Map expansion will allow for more POIs and more possibilities for other gameplay.
We have a temporary hardware pop-up store, I want to add horse riding into the game at some point along with some Vehicle things, like Vehicle damage and a mechanic to fix your car or something.
But to bring all that in we need more space. To me it feels weird to keep clearing out areas in the current playable area, and place POIs where they don't belong. Especially when just a few miles up the valley is an actual village. (I'm not yet saying the whole village will be there, but at least there is space.)

So Next up Map expansion and Horse Riding will have my focus.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42053219/200711491557f78630779377cf087e1baadd35f5.png


And as always feel free to drop your suggestions in the Discord or here on the Steam Forums, as well as questions and experiences!

A special thanks to @mmontes for reporting a bunch of bugs! <3

As always happy gaming, I hope you'll enjoy the update!
Thanks for your support and patience! <3

notes.title: NEW Update v0.0.04 - Memory Bank, NPC Cars and Felling Axe
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42053219/8c261aaaa8bcd0f7b8b36cb93e481c96bde19a9a.jpg



First things first, I'm sorry this Update took so long and has relatively little Content in it..
I wanted this update to include the Vendor/NPC Routines but after working on it for nearly a month and hitting a wall every other day I felt I should just put that aside for now.
Therefore we have this update now which makes the world feel a little more alive as well.

Update v0.0.04:

New Features:

 NPC/AI Vehicles Drive on main roads.
 Memory Bank - Available in the Inventory Topbar. 
 Felling Axe and new Animations for Tree chopping.


Changes:

 Lowered the Interaction length on items - You might need to scroll the camera in and out to find a sweet spot that works for you.
 Changed Texture size on some boulders to be less pixelated.
 Removed the Rusty Hatchet. - (If you had it and saved it should still work?)


Fixes:

 Fixed Voice Line when fueling vehicle.
 Fixed Car collision with trees and other vegetation.


Nerdy Dev Stuff:

 Not much..



Extra Info:
NPC Vehicles
The NPCs will brake and stop for you and other vehicles. However if you just run into the road, right in front of a car, as in real life the driver might not break fast enough and it might lead to injury or even result in death. So be careful.
At night their lights should automatically turn on. NPC vehicles will spawn at the start/end of the main roads and will disappear there as well. Also Vehicles may park in parking lots or spawn here.
For now collisions and accidents with your Ranger vehicle and NPCs will not have any consequences, but it will in the future.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42053219/cd09e1a64a219a1f091471d21a1ec877fa5c380d.png

Memory Bank
The memory Bank is accessible in the In game menu in the top bar.
Hear you can listen back to certain environment triggered voice lines, which may give clues about Theo's past or other clues...
You can also read back letters you may have found during exploration.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42053219/12c93c4e6408bff90c0bbaf9d49ed07d7aba2d8b.png


What is next?
For the next update I will start working in an actual story element. In the intro video you can see how the Radio Tower is being taken out by a lightning strike. 
In the next update you will be able to repair the Radio Relay Station by doing some kind of puzzle-ish activity and by completing it will fix the Station. 

Fixing the Radio Station will in turn allow you to turn on Radios found throughout the world (They will be added to POIs as well as the Ranger Vehicle) and listen to music while driving around or staying in cabins. Eventually you may even be able to buy a radio for your own, so you can place it in your own build cabins and such.

As a content creator myself I will make sure this music will NOT cause any Copyright issues on Youtube (or Twitch) for Streamers and Content Creators, if you do run into this please let me know ASAP!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42053219/4448512404d86bbc6174174e36bc8828d323bf43.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42053219/38593bcbed738f7965f3172828fabba307cc5497.png

As always happy gaming, I hope you'll enjoy the update!
Thanks for your support and patience! <3

notes.title: HOTFIX EA Reboot v0.0.02-H2 Update
notes.notes:
Hotfix:
While working on the Project during the DevStream yesterday I found a tiny bug that needed squashing.

I recreated the Widget that shows when you interact with a couch or bed. This widget let's you set the amount of hours you want to sleep for. I recreated this to allow for Controller Support.
However with setting this something went wrong for Keyboard and Mouse support.

- Fixed Mouse input and processing of Value of hours in "Amount of Hours to sleep Widget"

So if you have the most up to date and current version of the game in your Menu Screens you should see the version number on the right that shows:
[code]EA Reboot v0.0.02-H2[/code]


Next Content and current works:
Keys & KeyChain:
I also want to keep you up to date on what I'm working on, in means of content.
I have made great progress on the "Key System" and the locked doors. It seems that it's working as I intended, it will require additional testing. But for now when you find a key you can add it to your Keyring/Keychain to keep it safe and at the same time declutter the inventory.

New POI:
At the same time I'm adding another POI, for players that played the Legacy version this Cabin might seem familiar.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42053219/3b04a3f4f37c2221ce1d6f7da0bbe23d7ee89138.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42053219/d2da82f6257d80631e0c3fbad82c25498015caf9.png

"Electrical System":
In the meantime during the Devstream I started working on the "Electrical System". This is a system we also had in the Legacy version of the game in a way, and I am re-adding it and improving on it at the same time.
This means some cabins, will require a power source to use all functionalities.  Think of lights but also electric stoves. 
This in turn means that you might find a Generator somewhere near a POI that needs to be on. Before you can use the Electrical devices.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42053219/a28d37778e82357b4d71887df38812545bc395d2.png

I'm very excited to get all this back in the game, in the Meantime I also have to start Scoping out what I do and what I do not want to include in the next Content Update. Cause I can keep on adding and building. But that's not efficient. I want to release new content so you guys have more to do and at the same time not take too long or go to big.

Check out DevStreams:
Stay tuned for more news. And remember that I sometimes do DevStreams on Youtube where you will see some behind the scenes of the Progress and process of GAme Development as well as ask questions about it.
[previewyoutube=47hjuOn71fk;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: HOTFIX EA Reboot v0.0.02-H1 Update

Hey Guys,

As requested by the community I added this small Hotfix that allows the Controls for Vehicles to be remapped. It took a bit of figuring out but now you are able to remap the controls.

Patch Sizes...
Another thing I noticed and that I'm looking into is the Patch sizes...
I believe this current update requires a 18GB download? That's insane and I'm looking into optimizing this, it's an issue of "communication" and "understanding" between Unreal Engine and Steam.

Next Content and current works:
Another thing I wanted to tell you guys is, in the meantime I have been working on the next Content update, this one will be focused on bringing back the Keys and Locked doors system.

It's taking me a bit because of how the Inventory works, I wanted to create a sort of "SubInventory" if you will, that kinda functions like a KeyChain, so you put all your keys in there, it will both clean up your Inventory and they will just be organized in 1 logical place! :)

notes.title: Quick Update from Dev | What's going on behind the scenes.
notes.notes:
Hey Awesome people,
I wanted to update you guys quickly to let you know what is going on.

First of all thank you all for your support and patience through this journey, we have a vision and ambition that needs time to make great.

Sadly I had some family stuff going on a few weeks ago. My mother passed away and we have alot of work to do IRL to make make sure everything is handled properly and right.

That means I have not been working on YFR a lot the past few weeks. And I will not have the amount of time I used to have before this, for a while.

In the mean time we noticed alot of people having issues with their memory and the game somehow hogging all of it and basically choking their PC.

Long story short here is the deal for the upcoming weeks/month(s):
The Farming Update is as good as done, I was mostly tweaking some settings, timers and code.
However with the memory issues I feel not completely comfortable releasing the farming update in the current state.

I have been doing alot of optimization where I could but this might not be enough.

So.. What I'm going to do is: 
I'm going to completely check and optimize/replace the code base/foundation we build upon. To make sure it is the best it can be, this will take some time. But will yield great results in the long run.
At the same time we are aiming for a Realistic looking game Graphics wise and we use Unreal Engine 5 and their new features which (at least for now) come at a price. 
UE5 is still being developped and optimized by Epic Games and it will take time for them to see what kind of Specs they can run their features on. This will probably change somewhat in the coming year, meaning lower specs than current might be able to use the newer engine features.



YFR is still not dead, we need some time to make everything work better, we hear your concerns, we appologize. And to make matters worse Real Life is gonna demand more of me as well.

I'll keep you guys updated.
Thanks again for your patience.

If you have any questions or Concerns, 
Please feel free to reach out in the Community Forums here on Steam or in Discord: https://discord.gg/RnTKuJt

.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42053219/d6ad32fd87445c42f2a6d982fce2d788c449a87e.png

notes.title: Hotfix 3 | More Performance Optimization
notes.notes:
So I will be honest right away guys. 
I've been pulling my hair out with this. 
There are so many different things that go on within a Game Development process, usually there is a team of several people behind a game. I'm just 1 guy, solo, with a full time dayjob and a family.
I've spent nearly each evening on the issues at hand.

I feel like i got alot of FPS issues and hitches fixed.
However it is still hard to make it look great as well as make it perform well as well.

If the game is not running well for you, try tweaking the graphics settings.
Also try to lock it at 30 fps to see how that does. 
The gameplay does not require 60 or 144 fps, if you want that it is a personal choice and I can't garantee pretty looks and 120+ fps at these times. This is also due to the Unreal Engine 5 and their newest technologies not being well optimized yet. 


I have chnaged some technical stuff in the backgroudn trying to make the load of the game less heavy as well have a better experience at runtime.

I hope to god this works better than before, I see improvements, I hope you guys do too! :)

notes.title: Hotfix 2 | Saving Fixed, More Performance Optimizations
notes.notes:
Hey Guys,
I fixed the Save System in this Hotfix, took me all day to find that one line/one checkbox.. If you know, you know.. xD

Also Hacked down alot in the materials of alot of meshes so that the ShaderComplexity went down.
I also changed the amount of LandscapeGrass that is rendered on Epic Settings to make it look more pretty.

You can now ofcourse lower your settings to get Higher FPS, however:
If you change your Graphics to Medium or Low and Textures dissapear (Into gray blocks), up the Effects Setting (to High).

I'm not sure why this is happening, Unreal Engine 5.3 is very, very hungry on resources and has some weird behaviours. Hopefully Epic will fix this soon!

Enjoy, let me know if there are any issues!
See you in Discord or the Steam Forums! <3
With Warm Regards,
Thursten

notes.title: Quick Hotfix addressing some stupid small things.
notes.notes:
While working HARD on the WildLife update, I also push this Hotfix:

So upon watching some Content Creators I noticed the follwoing things and fixed/added the following:

- Food Cans no longer require Level 4 to consume. (This was an error from the start anyway)

- When you sleep your Fatigue used to get updated with [code]amount_of_SleepHours x 10[/code] this has been updated to [code]amount_of_SleepHours x 20[/code] so now you get twice as much, which is way more realistic! :)

- When you Sleep the weather also changes now to another Random Weather Type. (So you could sleep through Snowy and Colder weather if you don't have anythign to manage your perceived Temp yet)

- Disabled Dmage Text > The orange text that appears when you hit something is disabled cause it's misleading, it shows up even if you're not actually hitting something.

- Disabled random respawn location in radius for Stick-Saplings. (They spawned halfway in the air..)

Also a Thank you to user Pleabad in our Discord for getting us very useful information on the Map - Audio bug that somehow stops all ambient sound.

For now reloading from teh MAin menu is still your best option, we're still looking into viable ways of fixing!

notes.title: Early Access V002.1 Swimming, New Area and Temperature Management Update
notes.notes:
Early Access V002.1 Swimming, New Area and Temperature Management Update
Like it says above, this update adds a hidden new area, can you find it?

Hey guys!
Okay Guys, first of all.. I'm sorry it took so dang long before this update released. This update shouldn't have taken so long for the amount of content but I ran into several problems..
I was hoping this update would be a quick one with some easy new content and some fixes from the previous state of playabiliy But turned out it was a bit harder. Lessons learned!
The issues were mainly with the way Unreal handles swimming and certain audio triggers. (More in detail in DevNotes at the bottom.)

That said, with this new update we bring quite alot of changes and improvements I'm gonna try to mention it all, though I might forget some..
Please feel free to give your opinions and suggestions on this in a constructive manner and we will see what we can do about them! <3

Thank you guys for your patience, I wished I could drop the wildlife update already, but that is HUGE and will need more time! I'll keep you guys updated!
Luckily I can start working on this NEXT! =D
Thank you for playing and joining in on the Yosemite Forest Ranger journey! <3

PatchNotes:

New Content:
- Hidden new area to explore
- Swimming in the Lake (Rivers are NOT Swimmable.. They gave me Sh*t.)
     TOGGLE DIVING WITH Left alt
- Fahrenheit! USA USA!! (Selectable in the Settings menu)
- Different ways to manage your temperature
- Expansion of the beginner tutorial about woodchopping

New Items:
- 2 New food recipes
- 2 items for temperature management 
- Canned food
- Pickaxe (Equipment)
- 3 new forageables


Changes:
- Woosh sound FX when you miss-hit with the hatchet (or pickaxe) (instead of "tink")
- Weather and outside temperatures are more balanced and realistic with the IRL seasons and weather probabilities of Yosemite Valley, CA.

Bug fixes:
- Food consumption is way more balanced now
- Fatigue refill on sleep.
- Blocked staircase in Abandoned Village house
- Some hard to grab items on certain locations, now grab-able


DevNotes/Nerd Details:
- Swimming system took waaaay longer than I wanted. Unreal uses physics volumes to trigger the swimming movement mode and those are not easily modular, I have to place them manually throughout all the river parts to make the animations look good and for now I decided it was a waste of valuable time.
- The new area had some issues with lighting and sound and I wanted to fix that as well. I can't say too much because of spoilers! ;)

- Sadly no fix for the audio drops yet.. Definitely connected to the Map and the way the map audio is handled... It loads the voice lines in when you open the map. And the issues seem to be related to the way the engine handles audio that is loaded and killed upon closing the map... 
     Not an easy issue or fix sadly.  But a reloading to the Main Menu and back in game gets the sound back!
- I am experimenting with different ways to fix this or handle the map audio differently.
- Keep reporting any issues please!


If you guys want I can provide a more detailed list of the new stuff in Spoiler tags. Let me know if there is any interest!

Thanks for reading this and for the continued support! 
Now Finally onto the cool stuff!!! Next up I'll start with the WIldife update! (Yeah, finally! I know right..)

EDIT:
I've just uploadedd a DevVlog where I talk about this new update, the Struggles I had with it, Future plans and what's to come next, and some very excitiing Announcements!
Go check it out! <3

notes.title: New Hotfix! v002.0H02 and Plans for next bigger update.
notes.notes:
Here's what I fixed for now:

- Added the percieved temperature back into the HUD (Bottom right, it indicates the temp you feel.)

- Holding right mouse button will allow you to hunch again, if you have your hatchet equipped it allows you to chop higher and lower instead of the fixed height.

- The Third Person Active cam is set correctly now (I hope 😛) So the picking up in the beginning around the cabin is easier now.

- Maybe a bit mor ei forgot about..


Little Teaser guys:
Next bigger update (hopefully at the beginning of next month) will bring:
- Swimming 
- Better rivers and lakes. 
- I  will look at the temperature and make them more realistic
- Give you a "way" to manage your perceived temp better. 
- A first part of a whole new area to explore.
- Depending on the amount of time it takes I might even add an option to switch between Celsius and Fahrenheit. But again this depends on the amount of time implementation takes.

notes.title: Early Access V002.0 - Code Overhaul Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42053219/50479de596813db49297328d03f2300bcf55807b.jpg

Hey guys!
I've been working my buttocks off to get this update done as soon as possible, while still delivering my quality standards. I'm happy with this update, it turned out good and it will make big content updates in the future way easier to integrate! 
That said, with the whole code overhaul there might be some new bugs to arise or elements that are different than before. We did excessive testing, however with a small team sometimes things slip through the cracks. 
Please feel free to give your opinions and suggestions on this in a constructive manner and we will see what we can do about them!  Gives Firewood which burns longer than sticks.
- Sharpening Stone, spawns randomly at certain locations.
- Skill books which give XP
- Kitchen Cabinets as Storage, if this works well I'll add more. (Request your favorite locations!)

New Items:
- Rusty Hatchet (as equipment) for chopping tree stumps and debris
- Sharpening Stone (Used in repairing the Hatchet)
- Firewood burns longer than sticks
- TreeStumps and Branch debris placed all over the map
- Cooking books (Skill books)

Changes:
- New Save System, this means current savegames are NOT compatible. You'll have to start a new game. (Sorry!)
- Current state of crafting stations and other world interaction objects are SAVED NOW! (Meaning, Inventories, current crafting cue, current combustible etc.) 🥳
- Character movement and TP/FP are changed a bit. Character can bend over forward and backwards a bit (handy when chopping trees).
- Certain steps of the tutorial are time-skipped now, so won't get stuck if you don't read and picked stuff up before that step came in the tut.
- Recipe Books will spawn randomly at certain locations (No more fixed locations)
- [spoiler]In the Abandoned Village all sinks will have Dirty Water which makes you kinda sick, kitchen sinks only fill canteens on interaction, bathroom sinks are still drink and fill, at a cost for dire moments![/spoiler]
- I'm working on swimming so the Lake might look a little different through the coming updates!
- Red Spotted Mushrooms are even more dangerous raw.
- Fall damage is more severe and dangerous now, watch out with heights!

Bugfixes:
- Forageables and sticks don't spawn into each other anymore.
- When picking up a Tape it will dissapear right away instead of after voice line.

- Sadly no fix for the audio drops yet.. Looking into this HARD it's not an easy issue. It does seem to be related to opening/closing the map, it loads the voice lines in when you open the map. And the issues seem to be related to the way the engine handles audio that is loaded and killed upon closing the map... Not an easy issue or fix sadly. But a reloading to the Main Menu and back in gamee gets the sound back!

DevNotes/Nerd Details:
- Updated to the newest version of UIS therefore most of the code had to be rewritten. But this makes it easier to integrate other components down the line so it was worth it!
    - Therefore there might be some new bugs. I think we covered most...
- EMS is integrated and makes life good!
- Swimming system is being worked on, so the lake material changes through updates for testing what works and looks best!

By the way, how do you think Theo will do behind that computer? And yes kids, that's what PC's looked like in the 80's!
